summary_1line: Narada recounts how Brahma’s wrath nearly burns the universe until Sthanu intervenes, leading to the creation of Death to regulate birth and mortality.

image_candidates.scene_text: From Brahma’s enraged body a vast cosmic fire erupts, engulfing heaven, earth, and sky while terrified beings burn across the universe.
Sthanu stands before the blazing Brahma, pleading with folded hands as the universe burns around them.
A dark‑robed goddess named Death emerges from Brahma’s body while holding back tears in her cupped palms.
